settings.preferencesDescription: Configure default values for the application.
settings.dataExportDescription: Download all your data as a JSON file.
settings.restoreHint: Restore recreates all data from an export file. It only works on an account that does not contain any data yet. Email account passwords must be re-entered afterwards.
settings.modulesDescription: Choose which modules are shown. Data of disabled modules is kept.

ledger.description: Import bank CSVs, manage ledger accounts, and review transaction history.
ledger.reviewQueueDescription: Work through uncategorized or unconfirmed transactions one by one.
ledger.transactionsNeedReview: Transactions currently need confirmation or categorization.
ledger.categoryTreeDescription: Build and maintain your category tree and keyword match words.
ledger.deleteCategoryConfirm: This will delete the category "{{name}}". Transactions using it become uncategorized and need review again.
ledger.noCategories: No ledger categories yet. Create one to get started.
ledger.noReviewSelection: Select a transaction from the queue to review it.
ledger.noTransactionsToReview: No transactions need review right now.
ledger.unlinkTransferConfirm: This will remove the internal transfer link so the transaction can be categorized normally. Continue?
ledger.transferCategoryProtection: Internal transfers stay protected from category changes until you explicitly unlink them.
ledger.transferReviewProtection: This transaction is linked as an internal transfer. Unlink it first if you want to categorize it normally.
ledger.unlinkToSeeTransferCandidates: Unlink this transfer to choose a different candidate.

email.description: Configure mailboxes whose order emails are read by the LLM, and link the extracted orders to ledger transactions.
email.folderHint: IMAP folder or Gmail label that contains your order emails, e.g. INBOX or Orders. Only emails in this folder are sent to the LLM.
email.folderMissing: No folder chosen, scans are skipped. Edit the account to choose one.
email.draftsFolderHint: A second folder or label for emails such as contract confirmations, subscription notices or bills. Its emails are sent to the LLM and proposed as contracts, purchases or vehicle costs in the Kontor inbox. The mailbox is only changed if you choose below to move or delete decided emails.
email.draftsFolderSame: Choose a folder other than the one for order emails.

processed.drafts: Decided emails of the Kontor inbox folder
processed.keepHint: Nothing is changed in the mailbox; Kontor only remembers what it has processed.
processed.moveHint: Kontor moves each email to the chosen folder once it is processed. Emails it could not read or extract stay where they are.
processed.deleteHint: Kontor moves each email to the mailbox's trash once it is processed, or deletes it for good if the server has no trash folder. Emails it could not read or extract stay where they are.
processed.targetRequired: Choose the folder the emails are moved to.
processed.targetSame: Choose a folder that Kontor does not read.
processed.confirmDelete: Kontor will delete emails from this mailbox once it has processed them: order emails after the scan, emails of the Kontor inbox folder after you accept or reject their draft. Where the mail server has no trash folder they are gone for good.

ordersShown.move: Processed order emails are moved to {{folder}}

draftsShown.move: Decided Kontor inbox emails are moved to {{folder}}
draftsShown.delete: Decided Kontor inbox emails are deleted

email.draftsRunFailed_one: {{count}} email could not be processed and is retried later.
email.draftsRunFailed_other: {{count}} emails could not be processed and are retried later.
email.foldersNone: The mail server lists no folders. Enter the folder name by hand.
email.foldersNoMatch: No folder matches. A name the list does not show can still be saved.

foldersErrors.imap_login_failed: The mail server refused the login. Check username and password, or enter the folder name by hand.
foldersErrors.imap_unavailable: The folders could not be loaded from the mail server. Check host, port and TLS, or enter the folder name by hand.
foldersErrors.password_missing: Enter the password to load the folders.
foldersErrors.generic: The folders could not be loaded. Enter the folder name by hand.

email.preClassifyHint: One cheap LLM call per batch looks only at sender and subject and skips emails that are clearly not orders. Cheaper, but a missed order is not looked at again.
email.llmRequired: Email orders are extracted with the LLM. Configure the LLM endpoint on the server (LLM_BASE_URL) to scan emails.
email.scanPartial: The scan was incomplete; skipped emails are retried on the next scan.
email.scanPartialResumes: The scan was incomplete; it continues automatically in a few minutes.
email.scanHint: Use the folder scan for normal operation. Upload `.eml` files to process old messages manually. Both need the LLM.
email.ordersDescription: Review extracted orders and verify how they were linked to transactions.
email.reviewMatchDescription: Pick the ledger transaction or split-payment combination that belongs to this extracted email order.
email.candidateWindow: Showing payments booked from {{before}} days before to {{after}} days after the order date.
email.convertedTotal: About {{amount}} at the ECB rate of {{date}}; the bank charge usually differs by conversion fees.
email.amountNotComparable: No exchange rate is available for {{currency}}, so amounts cannot be compared. Pick the payment by date and counterparty.
email.showLaterCharges: Search up to a year later

balance.title: Balance
balance.none: No balance yet. Import a CSV export with a balance, sync the bank or set one by hand.
balance.driftHint: The balance for {{date}} does not match the one for {{previous}} plus the transactions in between. Transactions may be missing, skipped or imported twice.
balance.removeManualLabel: Remove the balance set by hand
balance.dialogDescription: The balance at the end of the chosen day, including every transaction booked up to it. Later transactions are added to it.
balance.amountInvalid: Enter an amount such as 1234,56 or -12,30.
balance.dateInvalid: Pick a day that is not in the future.
balance.bankUnavailableOldConsent: This consent was given before Kontor read balances. Re-authorize to load the balance.
balance.bankUnavailable: The bank reports no booked balance for this account.
balance.bankError: The balance could not be loaded at the last sync.

accountEdit.title: Edit account
accountEdit.description: IBAN and currency cannot be changed.

accountDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
accountDelete.description: This deletes the account for good, together with:
accountDelete.transactions_one: {{count}} transaction, with its categories, splits, notes and links
accountDelete.transactions_other: {{count}} transactions, with their categories, splits, notes and links
accountDelete.imports_one: {{count}} import; the file can be imported again
accountDelete.imports_other: {{count}} imports; the files can be imported again
accountDelete.references_one: {{count}} link to a contract, purchase or vehicle (the item itself stays)
accountDelete.references_other: {{count}} links to contracts, purchases or vehicles (the items themselves stay)
accountDelete.transfers_one: {{count}} internal transfer; its other side goes back to review
accountDelete.transfers_other: {{count}} internal transfers; their other sides go back to review
accountDelete.emailOrders_one: the link of {{count}} email order; it can be linked again
accountDelete.emailOrders_other: the links of {{count}} email orders; they can be linked again
accountDelete.bankAccount: the mapping of the bank account {{name}} at {{bank}}
accountDelete.afterwards: To sync again, map the bank account to another ledger account or create one from it on the bank connections page. A sync only brings back what the bank still provides.

suggestions.runRemaining_one: {{count}} transaction left, run again for it.
suggestions.runRemaining_other: {{count}} transactions left, run again for them.
suggestions.runNothing: No uncategorized transactions to suggest categories for.
suggestions.runIncomplete: Not every transaction could be processed; the rest is retried on the next run.

split.title: Split
split.description: Book a part of this transaction to another category, e.g. a cash withdrawal paid together with the shopping. The rest stays with the transaction's category.
split.transferLinked: A linked internal transfer cannot be split. Unlink it first.

problems.amount: Enter an amount above zero for every part, e.g. 150 or 150,00.
problems.category: Choose a category for every part.
problems.note: A note can have at most 500 characters.
problems.total: The parts must add up to less than the transaction amount.
problems.tooMany: A transaction can have at most 10 parts.

failure.not_found: transaction or category no longer exists

recurring.created_one: {{count}} recurring payment proposed as a contract in the inbox.
recurring.created_other: {{count}} recurring payments proposed as contracts in the inbox.
recurring.busy: Recurring payment detection is already running. Try again in a moment.

createFromTransaction.title: Create from this transaction
createFromTransaction.hint: Opens a prefilled form; the new entry is linked to this transaction right away.
createFromTransaction.cost: Create auto cost from this transaction
createFromTransaction.pickItemsHint: The linked order has several items. One purchase is created per selected item, each in its own form; closing a form skips that item.
createFromTransaction.linkFailed: The entry was created but could not be linked: {{message}}. Save the transaction to link it.

bankImport.title: Bank connections
bankImport.description: Import transactions automatically through Enable Banking. Bank data passes through Enable Banking.
bankImport.remoteNotClosed: The connection was removed here, but the bank session could not be closed. It ends by itself when the consent expires.
bankImport.changeMappingHint: Transactions already synced stay in their ledger account; new syncs go to the account you choose.
bankImport.unmapped: Mapping removed. The bank account is not synced until it is mapped again.

status.unmapped: Not mapped to a ledger account
status.access_denied: The bank denied access to this account
status.account_not_accessible: Account not accessible with this Enable Banking app
status.rate_limited: Rate limit reached, will retry later
status.app_error: Enable Banking rejected the app credentials

banner.expiring: The consent for {{bank}} ends on {{date}}. Authorize it again to keep importing.
banner.expired: The consent for {{bank}} has ended. Authorize it again to resume importing.

connect.title: Connect a bank
connect.description: Pick your bank. You will be sent there to approve read access to your accounts.

result.title: Bank connection
result.connected: The bank is connected. Map its accounts to ledger accounts to start importing.

reasons.denied: The connection was cancelled at the bank.
reasons.bank_error: The bank reported an error. Try again.
reasons.invalid_state: This link is invalid or has expired. Start the connection again.
reasons.missing_code: The bank did not return an authorization. Try again.
reasons.restricted: This Enable Banking app can only connect its owner's accounts.
reasons.failed: The connection could not be completed. Try again.
reasons.disabled: Bank import is not enabled on this server.
reasons.generic: The connection could not be completed.

errors.bank_import_disabled: Bank import is not enabled on this server.
errors.public_url_not_configured: The server has no PUBLIC_URL, so banks cannot be connected.
errors.bank_restricted: This Enable Banking app can only connect its owner's accounts.
errors.bank_unavailable: The bank service is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.redirect_url_not_allowed: Enable Banking does not accept the redirect URL. Register {{redirectUrl}} as redirect URL in the Enable Banking app.
errors.bank_request_rejected: Enable Banking rejected the request. The server log has the error code.
errors.bank_rate_limited: Rate limit reached. Try again later.
errors.sync_running: A sync is already running for this connection.
errors.consent_expired: The consent has expired. Authorize it again.
errors.invalid_mapping: This ledger account cannot be mapped to the bank account.
errors.sync_timeout: The sync did not finish in time. Imported rows are kept; run it again.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: Charts from your transactions and account balances.

problems.fromAfterTo: The start date must not be after the end date.

problems.toInFuture: The end date must not be in the future.

analysis.error: This analysis could not be loaded.

paperless.title: Paperless-ngx
paperless.settingsDescription: Connect your paperless-ngx instance to search and attach documents across Kontor.
paperless.tokenUnchangedHint: Leave empty to keep the current token
paperless.removeHint: Removing the connection keeps already attached document links.
paperless.searchDescription: Search your paperless archive and attach documents.

pipeline.title: Draft pipeline
pipeline.description: Tag a document with "{{inboxTag}}" in paperless and Kontor proposes a purchase, contract or vehicle cost from its text in your inbox. Accepting a draft replaces the tag with "{{doneTag}}".
pipeline.tagsHint: The inbox tag starts the pipeline. The linked tag marks documents attached to a Kontor entry and is also set when you attach documents manually.
pipeline.runFailed_one: {{count}} document could not be processed and will be retried later
pipeline.runFailed_other: {{count}} documents could not be processed and will be retried later

drafts.title: Inbox
drafts.description: Drafts proposed from your documents or created by agents. Nothing is created until you accept a draft.
drafts.acceptFailed: The entry was created, but the draft could not be accepted: {{message}}
drafts.hintPickType: Choose what this document is, or reject it.
drafts.hintModuleDisabled: This module is disabled. Choose another type or reject the draft.
drafts.hintNoCategories: Create a category in this module first.
drafts.hintPickCategory: Choose a category to accept the draft.
drafts.hintPickVehicle: Choose a vehicle to accept the draft.

notes.unclassified: The document could not be assigned to a type.
notes.empty_content: The document has no text (OCR content is empty).
notes.llm_invalid_output: The AI answer could not be used.
notes.llm_refused: The AI refused to process this document.
notes.llm_truncated: The AI answer was cut off.
notes.llm_request_rejected: The AI service rejected the document, it may be too long.
notes.currency_converted: The amount was converted to EUR at the ECB rate; the original amount is in the comments.
notes.currency_not_converted: The amount is in another currency and could not be converted to EUR; the original amount is in the comments.
notes.recurring_payment: Recurring payment detected in the ledger. Pick a category to create the contract; the payments are linked on accept.
notes.recurring_payment_ended: Recurring payment detected in the ledger; the payments have stopped, so the end date is the last payment. Pick a category to create the contract; the payments are linked on accept.

bulk.confirmDescription: The entries are created from the draft data as it is, without opening each form. Drafts that cannot be created stay in the inbox with the reason.
bulk.failed_one: {{count}} draft could not be accepted, see the reason on the draft
bulk.failed_other: {{count}} drafts could not be accepted, see the reason on each draft
bulk.requestFailed: The request failed, the remaining drafts were not processed: {{message}}

errors.no_type: Choose what this draft is first.
errors.module_disabled: The module of this draft is disabled.
errors.parent_missing: Choose a category or vehicle first.
errors.parent_not_found: The category or vehicle of this draft no longer exists.
errors.invalid_input: The entry could not be created: {{message}}
errors.source_link_failed: The entry was created, but its source could not be linked. Accept the draft again to retry; no second entry is created.

quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.description: Describe a purchase, contract or vehicle cost in your own words, or attach an invoice or receipt. The AI fills in the form, you check it.
quickAdd.placeholder: e.g. bought winter tires 2026-11-02 at Reifen Müller, €640, Golf
quickAdd.placeholderFile: Optional: add a hint, e.g. which vehicle this is for

errors.file_too_large: The file is too large (at most 10 MB).
errors.unsupported_file: This file type is not supported. Use a PDF, or a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.vision_not_configured: Photos are not available on this server. Attach a PDF instead.
errors.pdf_no_text: This PDF is a scan without text. Attach a photo of the document instead.
errors.file_unreadable: The PDF could not be read. It may be damaged or password protected.

quickAdd.hintCheck: Check the type and category, then continue. You can edit all fields in the next step.
quickAdd.currencyConverted: Converted from {{original}} at the ECB rate of {{date}} (1 {{code}} = {{rate}} EUR). Check the amount, your bank may have charged a different rate.
quickAdd.currencyNotConverted: The amount is {{original}} and could not be converted to EUR. Enter the EUR amount in the next step.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.description: Personal access tokens let agents and scripts use your data, for example an MCP client such as Claude Code or OpenCode. A token only does what its scopes allow.
tokens.createDescription: Choose a name, what the token may do and how long it is valid.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Code on my laptop

scopeHint.read: Read all your data, including exports
scopeHint.drafts: Create and decide drafts in the inbox
scopeHint.links: Link paperless documents and transactions to existing items
scopeHint.categorize: Change ledger categories, transaction categories and transfer links directly

scopeDetail.read: Read everything you can see, including the full data export and all modules. Search and list tools in MCP.
scopeDetail.drafts: Create drafts for the inbox (MCP) and edit, accept or reject drafts through the API. Nothing is created without your review in the UI.
scopeDetail.links: Attach paperless documents to existing contracts, purchases, vehicles, costs and transactions, and add references to transactions.
scopeDetail.categorize: MCP only, without a draft: rename and move ledger categories and edit their match words, set the category of a transaction (its review status stays) and link or unlink internal transfers. It cannot create or delete anything.

tokens.expiryInvalid: Choose a date in the future
tokens.neverWarning: A token that never expires stays valid until you revoke it. Prefer an expiry date.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke the token "{{name}}"? Clients using it lose access immediately.
tokens.revealDescription: Copy the token and store it in your client now.
tokens.revealWarning: This token will not be shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
tokens.snippetHint: Replace <your-token> with a token you created above.
tokens.noteRest: Tokens also work against the REST API within their scopes. Token management and the password change always need your login.
tokens.noteRead: A token with the read scope can read all your data, including the full export.
tokens.noteLeak: If a token leaks, revoke it immediately.
